name: 観測点付きの月間折れ線
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
One component only: LH17-0002 観測点付きの月間折れ線, to follow changes over observed time points. Produce one straight-on high fidelity Japanese chart, landscape approx390:205, crisp and compact on pure white #FFFFFF. A white rounded subtly elevated card with fine neutral border; no extra title, dashboard, navigation or invented controls.
REFERENCE PRIORITY: Image1 ORIGINAL Strava source controls fine chart details, observation-marker geometry, thin line weight, grid alignment, proportions and selection anatomy. Image2 our native mock is SECONDARY for Japanese month labels and isolated component layout; do not copy its omissions. Image3 approved bus style controls restrained white material, green depth and soft shadow only, with no bus/map artwork.
Observed source: a single orange time-series line with twelve observation points, hollow circle markers, a very light downward-fading area, light neutral grid; selected rightmost point is filled with a small translucent halo and a vertical indicator at the plot's right edge. Our mock omitted this selected indicator and the distance units. Restore those source details using the official forest-green single-series style. Do not copy surrounding app screen, English UI, photos, watermark or navigation.
Match observed line topology precisely: twelve regularly spaced points. Starting medium-low, up, highest46, sharp low, up to about25, near-zero, zero, zero, low around10, slightly higher around12, up to about25, ending at18. Keep the zero run flat, do not smooth away peaks or create extra points. Keep native preview's overall plot proportions and ample label room. Exactly twelve markers; first eleven white-filled circles with forest-green outlines, final solid forest-green point with a subtle localized halo and thin forest-green vertical line ending at plot top. The original endpoint label is18 km; keep it at upper-right above the selection line. No extra data labels.
Text verbatim: left axis 46 km / 23 km / 0 km. Bottom months 4月 / 5月 / 6月. Selected annotation18 km. Meiryo Regular metadata12/16, zero tracking; established weight and readable wrapping. Neutral dark-gray labels and fine light neutral grid. Keep all labels legible without clipping or collision.
Color: original orange means ONE data series and the selected endpoint, not a category rainbow. Adapt it consistently to #1F6444 forest green, with a restrained area fading to transparent white; neutral grid #D9DEDC. No broad mint panels, no decorative accents, no thick glossy lines. Pure white exterior and card. Preserve factual source values and twelve-point geometry. Apple Design clarity, careful alignment, compact composition and restrained depth. Static design candidate only, no application or editability claim.
reviewNotes: 原画を細部の優先根拠として目視。単一オレンジ系列を森林緑へ適応。モックで省かれた最終点の塗り・局所ハロー・縦線とkm表記を原画から復元。生成を目視し12観測点、46/23/0 km、18 km、4月5月6月、白面・淡い面積表示、欠落やクリップなしを確認。原画の中間数値は目視形状のみで厳密値未確定。フォント実体・所有者承認・ネイティブ編集可能性・実装は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
